source_arguments.statement:
theorem locFacetComplex_exact (M : Submonoid (MvPolynomial α k)) [IsLocalization M L]
    (facets : Finset ι) (c : ℕ)
    (om : ∀ T : Finset ι, locFacetQuot k Fam L T)
    (hdeg : ∀ T : Finset ι, T.card ≠ c + 1 → om T = 0)
    (hcoc : ∀ T : Finset ι, T ⊆ facets → locQuotCoboundary k Fam L om T = 0) :
    ∃ eta : ∀ T : Finset ι, locFacetQuot k Fam L T,
      (∀ T : Finset ι, T.card ≠ c → eta T = 0) ∧ (∀ T : Finset ι, ¬ T ⊆ facets → eta T = 0)
        ∧ ∀ T : Finset ι, T ⊆ facets → locQuotCoboundary k Fam L eta T = om T
source_arguments.source_statement:
theorem locFacetComplex_exact (M : Submonoid (MvPolynomial α k)) [IsLocalization M L]
    (facets : Finset ι) (c : ℕ)
    (om : ∀ T : Finset ι, locFacetQuot k Fam L T)
    (hdeg : ∀ T : Finset ι, T.card ≠ c + 1 → om T = 0)
    (hcoc : ∀ T : Finset ι, T ⊆ facets → locQuotCoboundary k Fam L om T = 0) :
    ∃ eta : ∀ T : Finset ι, locFacetQuot k Fam L T,
      (∀ T : Finset ι, T.card ≠ c → eta T = 0) ∧ (∀ T : Finset ι, ¬ T ⊆ facets → eta T = 0)
        ∧ ∀ T : Finset ι, T ⊆ facets → locQuotCoboundary k Fam L eta T = om T
source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  classical
  choose z hz using fun T : Finset ι =>
    Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective (I := locCapIdeal k Fam L T) (om T)
  have homz : om = fun S => Ideal.Quotient.mk (locCapIdeal k Fam L S) (z S) := (funext hz).symm
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := IsLocalization.exist_integer_multiples_of_finset M
    (facets.powerset.image z)
  have hzb : ∀ T : Finset ι, ∃ pT : MvPolynomial α k,
      T ⊆ facets → IsLocalization.mk' L pT b = z T := by
    intro T
    by_cases hT : T ⊆ facets
    · obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hb (z T) (Finset.mem_image_of_mem z (Finset.mem_powerset.mpr hT))
      refine ⟨w, fun _ => ?_⟩
      rw [IsLocalization.mk'_eq_iff_eq_mul, hw, Algebra.smul_def]
      ring
    · exact ⟨0, fun h => absurd h hT⟩
  choose p hp using hzb
  have hpz : ∀ T : Finset ι, T ⊆ facets →
      z T * algebraMap (MvPolynomial α k) L (b : MvPolynomial α k)
        = algebraMap (MvPolynomial α k) L (p T) := by
    intro T hT
    rw [← hp T hT, IsLocalization.mk'_spec]
  -- the localized cocycle condition, on representatives
  have hsum : ∀ T : Finset ι, T ⊆ facets →
      (∑ i ∈ T, faceSign L T i * z (T.erase i)) ∈ locCapIdeal k Fam L T := by
    intro T hT
    have hzero := hcoc T hT
    rw [homz, locQuotCoboundary_mk] at hzero
    exact Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mp hzero
  -- after multiplying by the common denominator it is a polynomial statement
  have hpsum : ∀ T : Finset ι, T ⊆ facets →
      algebraMap (MvPolynomial α k) L
          (∑ i ∈ T, faceSign (MvPolynomial α k) T i * p (T.erase i))
        ∈ locCapIdeal k Fam L T := by
    intro T hT
    have hmul := Ideal.mul_mem_right
      (algebraMap (MvPolynomial α k) L (b : MvPolynomial α k)) _ (hsum T hT)
    have hrw : (∑ i ∈ T, faceSign L T i * z (T.erase i))
          * algebraMap (MvPolynomial α k) L (b : MvPolynomial α k)
        = algebraMap (MvPolynomial α k) L
          (∑ i ∈ T, faceSign (MvPolynomial α k) T i * p (T.erase i)) := by
      rw [map_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i hi => ?_)
      have hsubi : T.erase i ⊆ facets := (Finset.erase_subset i T).trans hT
      rw [map_mul, algebraMap_faceSign, mul_assoc, hpz _ hsubi]
    rwa [hrw] at hmul
  -- one further denominator makes it a polynomial cocycle
  have hex : ∀ T : Finset ι, ∃ nT : MvPolynomial α k, nT ∈ M ∧ (T ⊆ facets →
      nT * (∑ i ∈ T, faceSign (MvPolynomial α k) T i * p (T.erase i)) ∈ capIdeal k Fam T) := by
    intro T
    by_cases hT : T ⊆ facets
    · have hmem := hpsum T hT
      rw [← IsLocalization.mk'_one (M := M) L, locCapIdeal,
        IsLocalization.mk'_mem_map_algebraMap_iff M L] at hmem
      obtain ⟨s, hsM, hs⟩ := hmem
      exact ⟨s, hsM, fun _ => hs⟩
    · exact ⟨1, one_mem M, fun h => absurd h hT⟩
  choose n hnM hn using hex
  set N : MvPolynomial α k := ∏ S ∈ facets.powerset, n S with hN
  have hNM : N ∈ M := Submonoid.prod_mem M (fun S _ => hnM S)
  set d : M := ⟨N * (b : MvPolynomial α k), M.mul_mem hNM b.2⟩ with hd
  -- the polynomial cochain
  set q : Finset ι → MvPolynomial α k :=
    fun T => if T.card = c + 1 ∧ T ⊆ facets then N * p T else 0 with hq
  set mu : ∀ T : Finset ι, facetQuot k Fam T :=
    fun T => Ideal.Quotient.mk (capIdeal k Fam T) (q T) with hmu
  have hqzero : ∀ T : Finset ι, ¬ (T.card = c + 1 ∧ T ⊆ facets) → q T = 0 := by
    intro T hT
    rw [hq]
    exact if_neg hT
  have hmudeg : ∀ T : Finset ι, T.card ≠ c + 1 → mu T = 0 := by
    intro T hT
    rw [hmu]
    simp only
    rw [hqzero T (fun hc => hT hc.1), map_zero]
  have hmusub : ∀ T : Finset ι, ¬ T ⊆ facets → mu T = 0 := by
    intro T hT
    rw [hmu]
    simp only
    rw [hqzero T (fun hc => hT hc.2), map_zero]
  have hmucoc : ∀ T : Finset ι, T ⊆ facets → quotCoboundary k Fam mu T = 0 := by
    intro T hT
    rw [hmu, quotCoboundary_mk_sum, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
    by_cases hcard : T.card = c + 2
    · have hterm : ∀ i ∈ T, faceSign (MvPolynomial α k) T i * q (T.erase i)
          = N * (faceSign (MvPolynomial α k) T i * p (T.erase i)) := by
        intro i hi
        have hc1 : (T.erase i).card = c + 1 := by
          rw [Finset.card_erase_of_mem hi, hcard]
          omega
        have hs1 : T.erase i ⊆ facets := (Finset.erase_subset i T).trans hT
        rw [hq]
        simp only
        rw [if_pos ⟨hc1, hs1⟩]
        ring
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hterm, ← Finset.mul_sum]
      have hmemT : T ∈ facets.powerset := Finset.mem_powerset.mpr hT

Fix two `ℚ`-independent shifts `α, β` and let `x` be a nonzero element of the global meromorphic
differential field.  Its multiplicative translation cocycle is `σ_q x / x`.  Call the cocycle

`σ_α x / x = (σ_α b / b) · c₁`,  `σ_β x / x = (σ_β b / b) · c₂`

/-!
# Cohomological Hasse exactness for section defects

The global one-cochain coboundary map, closed local two-cochains, and second constraint
cohomology form an exact right-surjective sequence.  Thus local section-defect data arise from one
global choice exactly when their cocycle lies in the coboundary range, equivalently when their
obstruction class vanishes.  This is a cohomological Hasse principle independent of arithmetic
places.
-/

noncomputable section

namespace GaloisForLFunctions.RHTower

variable {G A : Type*} [Group G] [AddCommGroup A] [DistribMulAction G A]

/-- Coboundary operator bundled as an additive map from global one-cochains to closed local
two-cochains. -/
def twoCoboundaryCocycleAddHom : (G → A) →+ twoCocycles (G := G) (A := A) where
  toFun := twoCoboundaryCocycle
  map_zero' := twoCoboundaryCocycle_zero
  map_add' := twoCoboundaryCocycle_add

@[simp] theorem twoCoboundaryCocycleAddHom_apply (b : G → A) :
    twoCoboundaryCocycleAddHom b = twoCoboundaryCocycle b := rfl

/-- Canonical additive obstruction map from cocycles to second constraint cohomology. -/
def obstructionClassAddHom :
    twoCocycles (G := G) (A := A) →+
      secondConstraintCohomology (G := G) (A := A) :=
  QuotientAddGroup.mk' (twoCoboundaries (G := G) (A := A))

@[simp] theorem obstructionClassAddHom_apply
    (omega : twoCocycles (G := G) (A := A)) :
    obstructionClassAddHom omega = obstructionClass omega := rfl

/-- Global one-cochains, closed local two-cochains, and obstruction classes are exact. -/
theorem twoCoboundaryCocycle_obstructionClass_exact :
    Function.Exact
      (twoCoboundaryCocycleAddHom (G := G) (A := A))
      (obstructionClassAddHom (G := G) (A := A)) := by
  intro omega
  change obstructionClass omega = 0 ↔
    omega ∈ Set.range (twoCoboundaryCocycleAddHom (G := G) (A := A))
  rw [obstructionClass_eq_zero_iff_exists_cochain]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨b, hb⟩
    exact ⟨b, hb.symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨b, hb⟩
    exact ⟨b, hb.symm⟩

/-- Every second-cohomology obstruction class has a closed local cocycle representative. -/
theorem obstructionClassAddHom_surjective :
    Function.Surjective (obstructionClassAddHom (G := G) (A := A)) :=
  QuotientAddGroup.mk'_surjective (twoCoboundaries (G := G) (A := A))

/-- The cohomological local--global Hasse sequence is exact and right-surjective. -/
theorem omegaHasseSequence_exact_surjective :
    Function.Exact
        (twoCoboundaryCocycleAddHom (G := G) (A := A))
        (obstructionClassAddHom (G := G) (A := A)) ∧
      Function.Surjective (obstructionClassAddHom (G := G) (A := A)) :=
  ⟨twoCoboundaryCocycle_obstructionClass_exact,
    obstructionClassAddHom_surjective⟩

/-- Cocycles modulo globally induced coboundaries are exactly obstruction classes. -/
noncomputable def omegaHasseCocycleQuotientEquivObstruction :
    twoCocycles (G := G) (A := A) ⧸
        (twoCoboundaryCocycleAddHom (G := G) (A := A)).range ≃+
      secondConstraintCohomology (G := G) (A := A) := by
  have hker : (obstructionClassAddHom (G := G) (A := A)).ker =
      (twoCoboundaryCocycleAddHom (G := G) (A := A)).range := by
    have hexact := twoCoboundaryCocycle_obstructionClass_exact (G := G) (A := A)
    rw [AddMonoidHom.exact_iff] at hexact
    exact hexact
  exact (QuotientAddGroup.quotientAddEquivOfEq hker.symm).trans
    (QuotientAddGroup.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective
      (obstructionClassAddHom (G := G) (A := A))
      (obstructionClassAddHom_surjective (G := G) (A := A)))

/-- Evaluation of the Hasse quotient equivalence is the original obstruction class. -/
theorem omegaHasseCocycleQuotientEquivObstruction_mk
    (omega : twoCocycles (G := G) (A := A)) :
    omegaHasseCocycleQuotientEquivObstruction
        (QuotientAddGroup.mk omega) = obstructionClass omega := by
  simp [omegaHasseCocycleQuotientEquivObstruction]
  change QuotientAddGroup.kerLift
      (obstructionClassAddHom (G := G) (A := A))
      (QuotientAddGroup.mk omega) = obstructionClass omega
  rfl

/-- Section-defect Hasse criterion: local section data come from one global choice exactly when
their closed cocycle lies in the global coboundary range, equivalently when obstruction vanishes. -/
theorem SectionDefect.exists_global_choice_iff_cocycle_mem_coboundary_range
    (D : SectionDefect G A) :
    (∃ b : G → A, D.defect = twoCoboundary b) ↔
      D.cocycle ∈ (twoCoboundaryCocycleAddHom (G := G) (A := A)).range := by
  rw [← D.obstruction_eq_zero_iff_exists_global_choice]
  exact (twoCoboundaryCocycle_obstructionClass_exact (G := G) (A := A) D.cocycle)

end GaloisForLFunctions.RHTower

/-!
# Finite-prime quasi-local charge amplification

Adding an independent finite local degree of freedom sends a matrix family `M` to
`M ⊗ I_d`.  Its determinant is the `d`th power of the old determinant.  Consequently its
determinant winding is multiplied by `d`: independent tensor enlargement can amplify an existing
integer charge but cannot create one from zero.

On paper this is the finite core of the AF thermodynamic no-nucleation theorem.  Operator K-theory
commutes with inductive limits, so a norm-regular quasi-local limit of finite matrix algebras has no
parameterized K-theory charge without a finite-stage ancestor.
-/

open scoped Kronecker

noncomputable section

namespace PrimeQuasiLocalCharge

variable {m : Type*} [Fintype m] [DecidableEq m]

/-- Enlarge a finite matrix observable by an independent `d`-dimensional local identity factor. -/
def amplifyMatrix (d : ℕ) (A : Matrix m m ℂ) :
    Matrix (m × Fin d) (m × Fin d) ℂ :=
  A ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ)

/-- Independent tensor enlargement raises the determinant to the local dimension. -/
theorem det_amplifyMatrix (d : ℕ) (A : Matrix m m ℂ) :
    Matrix.det (amplifyMatrix d A) = Matrix.det A ^ d := by
  simp [amplifyMatrix, Matrix.det_kronecker]

/-- A positive-dimensional independent tensor factor cannot create or remove a determinant zero. -/
theorem det_amplifyMatrix_eq_zero_iff (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (A : Matrix m m ℂ) :
    Matrix.det (amplifyMatrix d A) = 0 ↔ Matrix.det A = 0 := by
  rw [det_amplifyMatrix]
  exact pow_eq_zero_iff hd.ne'

/-- The scalar determinant loop of a finite matrix family. -/
def determinantLoop (M : ℝ → Matrix m m ℂ) : ℝ → ℂ :=
  fun t => Matrix.det (M t)

/-- The determinant loop after adjoining an independent local identity factor. -/
def amplifiedDeterminantLoop (d : ℕ) (M : ℝ → Matrix m m ℂ) : ℝ → ℂ :=
  fun t => Matrix.det (amplifyMatrix d (M t))

theorem amplifiedDeterminantLoop_eq_pow (d : ℕ) (M : ℝ → Matrix m m ℂ) :
    amplifiedDeterminantLoop d M = fun t => determinantLoop M t ^ d := by
  funext t
  exact det_amplifyMatrix d (M t)

/-- The determinant winding is multiplied by the dimension of the adjoined local factor. -/
theorem windingNumber_amplifiedDeterminantLoop
    (d : ℕ) (M : ℝ → Matrix m m ℂ) {a b : ℝ}
    (hloop : RHTower.IsLoop (determinantLoop M) a b) :
    RHTower.windingNumber (amplifiedDeterminantLoop d M) a b =
      d * RHTower.windingNumber (determinantLoop M) a b := by
  rw [amplifiedDeterminantLoop_eq_pow]
  exact RHTower.windingNumber_pow hloop d

/-- **Finite-stage no-nucleation.**  Adjoining a positive-dimensional independent local system has
zero determinant winding exactly when the original system does. -/
theorem windingNumber_amplifiedDeterminantLoop_eq_zero_iff
    (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (M : ℝ → Matrix m m ℂ) {a b : ℝ}
    (hloop : RHTower.IsLoop (determinantLoop M) a b) :
    RHTower.windingNumber (amplifiedDeterminantLoop d M) a b = 0 ↔
      RHTower.windingNumber (determinantLoop M) a b = 0 := by
  rw [windingNumber_amplifiedDeterminantLoop d M hloop]
  constructor
  · intro h
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h with hdz | hw
    · have hdZ : (d : ℤ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hd.ne'
      exact (hdZ hdz).elim
    · exact hw
  · intro h
    rw [h, mul_zero]

/-- **Positive finite-ancestor theorem.**  A nonzero winding after independent tensor enlargement
already comes from a nonzero winding before the new local degree of freedom was adjoined. -/
theorem nonzero_winding_has_finiteAncestor
    (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (M : ℝ → Matrix m m ℂ) {a b : ℝ}
    (hloop : RHTower.IsLoop (determinantLoop M) a b)
    (hcharge : RHTower.windingNumber (amplifiedDeterminantLoop d M) a b ≠ 0) :
    RHTower.windingNumber (determinantLoop M) a b ≠ 0 := by
  intro hzero
  apply hcharge
  exact (windingNumber_amplifiedDeterminantLoop_eq_zero_iff d hd M hloop).2 hzero

end PrimeQuasiLocalCharge

/-!
# Relative boundary transgression of the Calderón--Witt source

The algebraic Calderón--Witt Milnor complex is contractible.  Consequently
an exterior cocycle cannot carry an absolute source-cohomology class.  After
restricting the admitted incidence primitives to a sector `S`, its complete
remaining invariant is the Green primitive modulo `S`.

This file specializes the general relative-contraction law to both the
one-prime and all-prime arithmetic sources.  It gives a necessity-and-
sufficiency theorem: the relative class vanishes exactly when the canonical
Green contraction preserves the admitted sector.
-/

namespace RHTower

noncomputable section

open GaloisForLFunctions.HTGeometry

/-! ## One-prime relative class -/

/--
Relative class of a local exterior source cocycle after restricting its
admitted Milnor-incidence primitives to `S`.
-/
def deningerCalderonWittRelativeBoundaryClass
    (p : Nat.Primes)
    (S : Submodule ℂ (deningerCalderonWittMilnorIncidence p))
    (w : ⋀[ℂ]^2 (DeningerCalderonWittAlgebraicDegreeOne p)) :=
  relativePrimitiveObstruction
    (R := ℂ)
    (A0 := deningerCalderonWittMilnorIncidence p)
    (A1 := ⋀[ℂ]^2 (DeningerCalderonWittAlgebraicDegreeOne p))
    S
    (deningerCalderonWittMilnorIncidence p).subtype
    (deningerCalderonWittMilnorGreenRetraction p)
    w

/--
**Local acyclic-source boundary-transgression law.**  For a local exterior
cocycle, the relative boundary class vanishes exactly when its canonical
Green primitive belongs to the admitted incidence sector.
-/
theorem deningerCalderonWittRelativeBoundaryClass_eq_zero_iff
    (p : Nat.Primes)
    (S : Submodule ℂ (deningerCalderonWittMilnorIncidence p))
    (w : ⋀[ℂ]^2 (DeningerCalderonWittAlgebraicDegreeOne p))
    (hcocycle : deningerCalderonWittAlgebraicExteriorCup p w = 0) :
    deningerCalderonWittRelativeBoundaryClass p S w = 0 ↔
      deningerCalderonWittMilnorGreenRetraction p w ∈ S := by
  simpa [deningerCalderonWittRelativeBoundaryClass] using
    (contractedCocycle_relativePrimitiveObstruction_eq_zero_iff_of_injective
      (R := ℂ)
      (A0 := deningerCalderonWittMilnorIncidence p)
      (A1 := ⋀[ℂ]^2 (DeningerCalderonWittAlgebraicDegreeOne p))
      (A2 := DeningerCalderonWittAlgebraicDegreeTwo p)
      (S0 := S)
      (d0 := (deningerCalderonWittMilnorIncidence p).subtype)
      (d1 := deningerCalderonWittAlgebraicExteriorCup p)
      (h1 := deningerCalderonWittMilnorGreenRetraction p)
      (h2 := deningerCalderonWittExteriorCupSection p)
      (hcontract := deningerCalderonWittMilnorGreenContraction_middle p)
      (hinjective :=
        (deningerCalderonWittMilnorIncidence p).subtype_injective)
      (x := w)
      hcocycle)

/-- On the exact Milnor-incidence source, cocycle closure is intrinsic to
the type, so the local boundary-transgression law has no separate closure
premise. -/
theorem deningerCalderonWittRelativeBoundaryClass_incidence_eq_zero_iff
    (p : Nat.Primes)
    (S : Submodule ℂ (deningerCalderonWittMilnorIncidence p))
    (w : deningerCalderonWittMilnorIncidence p) :
    deningerCalderonWittRelativeBoundaryClass p S w.1 = 0 ↔
      deningerCalderonWittMilnorGreenRetraction p w.1 ∈ S :=
  deningerCalderonWittRelativeBoundaryClass_eq_zero_iff
    p S w.1 w.2

/--
Equivalent local existence form: vanishing means precisely that the exterior
cocycle has an incidence primitive in the admitted sector.
-/
theorem deningerCalderonWittRelativeBoundaryClass_eq_zero_iff_exists
    (p : Nat.Primes)
    (S : Submodule ℂ (deningerCalderonWittMilnorIncidence p))
    (w : ⋀[ℂ]^2 (DeningerCalderonWittAlgebraicDegreeOne p))
    (hcocycle : deningerCalderonWittAlgebraicExteriorCup p w = 0) :
    deningerCalderonWittRelativeBoundaryClass p S w = 0 ↔
      ∃ i : deningerCalderonWittMilnorIncidence p,
        i ∈ S ∧
          (deningerCalderonWittMilnorIncidence p).subtype i = w := by
  simpa [deningerCalderonWittRelativeBoundaryClass] using
    (contractedCocycle_relativePrimitiveObstruction_eq_zero_iff
      (R := ℂ)
      (A0 := deningerCalderonWittMilnorIncidence p)
      (A1 := ⋀[ℂ]^2 (DeningerCalderonWittAlgebraicDegreeOne p))
      (A2 := DeningerCalderonWittAlgebraicDegreeTwo p)
      (S0 := S)
      (d0 := (deningerCalderonWittMilnorIncidence p).subtype)
      (d1 := deningerCalderonWittAlgebraicExteriorCup p)
      (h1 := deningerCalderonWittMilnorGreenRetraction p)
      (h2 := deningerCalderonWittExteriorCupSection p)
      (hcontract := deningerCalderonWittMilnorGreenContraction_middle p)
      (x := w)
      hcocycle)
